name: Udai Kensuke
source:
A young salesman in his third year at Ninmori Trading Company, a business specializing in selling PC applications.

Due to a shortage of personnel at one of the company's branches, he is ordered to transfer there temporarily for 6 months.

He feels lonely at the prospect of living apart from his girlfriend, but resolves to regard this separation as another test of their love and sets off for his new workplace.

He tends to adopt a somewhat domineering, traditional husband-like attitude toward Ayumu. However, when dealing with other women, he is comparatively more passive and often allows them to take the initiative.

Although he intends to devote his life exclusively to Ayumu, he is also the kind of man who can easily succumb to temptation. In that sense, he is relatively faithful to his own instincts and desires.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
